description: Search APIs listed in Odile Machine Access. Each is a domain-verified access contract: the calls an AI agent may make, the owner's price for each in credits (1 credit = USD 0.10; 0 is free), rate and daily limits, and a connect URL. Read-only; connecting is an HTTP POST to the connect URL.

query.description: Words to look for in the name, description, host or allowed calls, e.g. "email check"; leave out to list every contract
